summary: Tested Cthulhu HtmlViewer content-sniffing fix. The fix correctly detects PNG image data in .html extension files and renders them as tags instead of showing raw binary text. All 7 test scenarios passed: GEN2 ROBOT PNG (shows image with 'image detected' badge), GEN2 ROBOT HTML (renders generative art in iframe), STARGATE PDF (shows PDF viewer with Open/Download buttons), OUTERSPACE audio (shows audio player with Download fallback), Alien audio (shows audio player with cover art), Storefront (loads object cards), Main Feed (loads without errors).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Content-sniffing fix verified working. The sniffBlobType function (line ~441) correctly detects PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP magic bytes and the HtmlViewer component (line ~463) renders detected images as tags with data-testid='html-sniffed-image'. Look for 'image detected' badge to confirm content-sniffing is active. Audio playback fails in headless browser (expected - no audio codecs) but Download Audio fallback works.
